generationPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit and product compositing. Create a premium cohesive group product photograph for a drinks retailer website, landscape 3:2.
Image 1 is the current six-bottle group photo with a pale white background: this is the edit target and establishes the six-product grouping and left-to-right order.
Image 2 is the source collage of ALL SIX individual bottle advertisements (top row Schwarzer Teufel, Weisser Engel, Caramello; bottom row Süsse Sünde, Dicke Nüsse, Pralle Kirsche). It is the authoritative product-appearance and background-style reference for all six. Images 3, 4 and 5 are additional high-resolution detail references for Schwarzer Teufel, Weisser Engel and Caramello.
Replace the plain white environment with the shared aesthetic of these individual posters: deep almost-black studio background, subtle amber/gold floating specks and restrained red and green accent glow behind the corresponding bottles, dark polished tabletop with physically plausible soft reflections. Restrained, high-end, editorial, photorealistic product photography; no bar scenery and no bright white background.
Show exactly SIX complete upright cork-stoppered clear glass 0.7-litre bottles in a single balanced group, all six silhouettes and all labels fully visible, fronts facing camera, no overlap across labels, comfortable margins around corks and bases. Keep the bottle shapes, long neck proportions, cork caps, label typography, mascot illustrations, and liquid appearance faithful to each corresponding individual reference. Do not redesign any label. The individual references take precedence for the look of each bottle. From left to right:
1 DICKE NÜSSE, hazelnut mascot, golden hazelnut liqueur, 18% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
2 PRALLE KIRSCHE, cherry mascot, dark ruby liquid, 15% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
3 SCHWARZER TEUFEL, green-accent devil mascot and black liquid, 20% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
4 WEISSER ENGEL, angel mascot, clear pale anis liquid as in its individual poster, 21% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
5 SÜSSE SÜNDE, vanilla flower mascot, creamy pale vanilla liquid, 15% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
6 CARAMELLO, caramel mascot, golden caramel liquid, 20% VOL., 0,7 LITER.
Faithfully reproduce existing text ON the labels as seen in the corresponding reference. Product identity preservation is more important than elaborate effects. Do not carry over poster headings, explanatory columns, slogans outside labels, QR codes, icons or borders. No people, hands, glasses, added props, additional bottles, price badges, watermark or invented text. Keep all six bottles convincingly lit as one shared photographic scene.
